description: XPC-4.3 (#5747) Buf rule corpus: one .proto change per case, the grade expected under each buf breaking category, and the categories where the roadmap deliberately departs from buf. recordings.json (scripts/record_proto_breaking_fixtures.py) holds each side's compiled descriptor set and buf's own findings.

cases.note: Dropping a reservation breaks nothing yet, but lets a later change reuse the number or name.

known_disagreements.WIRE: XPC-4.3 decision: removing a reservation is dangerous; buf's RESERVED_MESSAGE_NO_DELETE calls it breaking
known_disagreements.WIRE_JSON: XPC-4.3 decision: removing a reservation is dangerous; buf's RESERVED_MESSAGE_NO_DELETE calls it breaking
known_disagreements.PACKAGE: XPC-4.3 decision: removing a reservation is dangerous; buf's RESERVED_MESSAGE_NO_DELETE calls it breaking
known_disagreements.FILE: XPC-4.3 decision: removing a reservation is dangerous; buf's RESERVED_MESSAGE_NO_DELETE calls it breaking

cases.note: A number retired by reservation now carries a new field.
A reserved name is used again.
An enum number retired by reservation is used again.
Neither the number nor the name is reserved.

known_disagreements.WIRE: XPC-4.3 decision: an unreserved deletion is dangerous under WIRE; buf's FIELD_NO_DELETE_UNLESS_NUMBER_RESERVED calls it breaking

cases.note: The number is reserved, the name is not.
Number and name reserved: wire- and JSON-safe, but generated code loses the field.
Same number and type, new name.
The number now carries a field of another type.
The JSON key moves from userName to login.
N moves to another file in the same package.
The only file is renamed.
The package changes, so M's full name does.
Number 1 now has another name.
E_A is sent as another number.
Two fields join a oneof.
A field leaves its oneof.
Singular becomes repeated.
proto3 optional adds presence tracking: same bytes, new generated API.
proto3 optional removed.
Old readers reject a message without the field.
New readers reject messages old writers send without it.
Reserving more numbers is always compatible.
